title: Short reply? 3 reasons it's NOT about you 💬 #shorts
description:
A short reply. A late reply. Your brain says "they're mad at you", but that's mind reading: guessing, not knowing. Come up with three other reasons: they're busy, they're tired, they just text like that. Most of the time the answer is "Of course. Why?" 💬 Send this to the friend who replies "k".

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/1nVuUlwU6Vk

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
